name: msp-atlas
description: Self-hosted IT documentation and password manager for MSPs

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @atlas/server & npm run dev -w @atlas/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @atlas/shared -w @atlas/db && npm run build -w @atlas/web && npm run build -w @atlas/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/db apps/server && npm run typecheck -w @atlas/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
